policy.notes: Ignored local source files must be pinned here before source assignments can be imported into the JLPT kanji source-evidence manifest. This layer is read-only and must not move kanji, move words, or change readiness.

tanos_legacy_direct.integrityPolicy: The ignored normalized TSV must match the tracked SHA-256, byte size, and parsed row count before import. This Tanos direct legacy lane imports only the explicitly reviewed N1, N4, and N5 base lists. N2 and N3 are intentionally excluded from this lane and must use a separate estimated-source lane if activated later.

tanos_estimated_split.integrityPolicy: The ignored normalized TSV must match the tracked SHA-256, byte size, and parsed row count before import. This lane imports only Tanos N2 and N3 estimated split kanji lists, keeps them separate from the direct legacy lane, and must stay visibly lower-weight estimated evidence.

kanjidic2_legacy.defaultCitation: EDRDG KANJIDIC2 legacy JLPT metadata; KANJIDIC Project, CC BY-SA 4.0.
kanjidic2_legacy.integrityPolicy: The ignored normalized TSV must match the tracked SHA-256, byte size, and parsed row count before import. Legacy JLPT level 2 is retained as N2/N3 range evidence and must not be converted into an exact N2 or N3 vote.

jlptsensei.integrityPolicy: This source input is for manually reviewed minimal level judgments from JLPT Sensei kanji pages only. Do not scrape, copy, or republish JLPT Sensei list content. Pin SHA-256, byte size, row count, and checkedAt only after the reviewed TSV contains permitted citations and evidence references.

shin_kanzen_master_kanji.integrityPolicy: This source input is for manually reviewed level judgments from Shin Kanzen Master kanji textbooks only. Do not copy copyrighted kanji lists. Pin SHA-256, byte size, row count, and checkedAt only after the reviewed TSV contains permitted citations and evidence references.

nihongo_sou_matome_kanji.integrityPolicy: This source input is for manually reviewed level judgments from Nihongo Sou Matome kanji textbooks only. Do not copy copyrighted kanji lists. Pin SHA-256, byte size, row count, and checkedAt only after the reviewed TSV contains permitted citations and evidence references.

try_jlpt_textbook.integrityPolicy: This source input is for manually reviewed level-study judgments from the TRY! JLPT series only. Do not copy copyrighted lists. Pin SHA-256, byte size, row count, and checkedAt only after the reviewed TSV contains permitted citations and evidence references.

ask_hajimete_jlpt_kanji.integrityPolicy: This source input is for manually reviewed level judgments from ASK Publishing's Hajimete no Nihongo Noryoku Shiken kanji books only. Official product pages currently identify N1, N2, and N3 kanji volumes; N5 is permitted only for the separately verified official sample page explicitly labeled N5 Kanji Checklist, and N4 remains unsupported until exact permitted source access is separately verified. Do not copy copyrighted kanji lists. Pin SHA-256, byte size, row count, and checkedAt only after the reviewed TSV contains permitted citations and evidence references.
